before: Uncertainty was estimated by stratified case bootstrap with 4,000 replicates, resampling PVOD and comparator patients separately at their observed group sizes and re-deriving every quantity inside each replicate, so that quantities derived under different procedures remain comparable.
after: The Figure 1 band was estimated by stratified case bootstrap, resampling PVOD and comparator patients separately at their observed group sizes. Nine of 4,000 stratified bootstrap resamples produced complete separation, for which the maximum likelihood estimate is not finite. Percentile intervals for the Figure 1 band were computed from the 3,991 resamples with finite fits. Excluding the nine leaves the upper edge effectively unchanged at and below the published cutoff and narrows it within the extrapolated tail, by approximately 2% at 2,156 pg/mL and 17% at 5,000 pg/mL. The existing AUC and paired threshold/landmark comparisons use stratified case resampling; comparator-specific bands and the retained supplementary intervals use the original parametric bootstrap.
reason: Approved Figure 1 finite-fit accounting and explicit scope; existing estimators unchanged

before: the band is a 95% stratified case bootstrap interval over 4,000 replicates.
